description: BV Labs is a team of four, Zehra Dizlek, Yasemin Yılmaz, Aslı Nur Demirkol and Ayşe Cengiz, working on the Field Shift challenge. We combine software development, data analysis and an interest in sustainable agriculture. Our project, WAGRO, uses NASA Earth observation data to help farmers choose crop rotations that protect soil and save water, with explainable rules, statistics, unsupervised machine learning and optimization.
